The intended experience is a calm encounter with the garment surface and the wearer's settled presence. baseline_prompt_en: A natural photograph of a fictional adult model wearing a decorated long Daoist ceremonial-style robe in a wood-lined studio with a large window, late in the afternoon just after rain. The model stands quietly in the room with their back toward the camera. The capture camera looks directly toward the model's back, presenting the decorated back of the robe clearly from the shoulders down to the hem. A full-length frame includes the robe's complete lower edge and the floor beneath it. Soft window light settles across the garment, bringing out its surface decoration and the natural weight of its folds. The sleeves hang comfortably beside the body, leaving the broad back readable. Small rain beads on the window catch a little of the fading daylight, while the timber walls hold a quiet indoor atmosphere. The model's relaxed shoulders and settled stance give the portrait an understated, self-possessed appeal. Keep the cloth and its decoration crisp enough to read, with the window and timber gently receding in attention.
